tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: The centre of mass of a solid hemisphere of radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> from the centre of the flat surface. Then value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is

solution.text:
Centre of Mass of a solid hemisphere from centre of the  flat surface is given by,hcm=3R8

It is given that R= 8 cm

Therefore,

 x=hcm=3R8=3×88x=3 cm
